pattern.short_summary: The same collection is presented at more than one level of granularity, from an aggregate summary down to a single item.
pattern.definition: The same collection is presented at more than one level of granularity, from an aggregate summary down to a single item. Interaction at a coarser level selects the population shown at the finer level. The finest level exposes the individual case behind the aggregate.
pattern.structural_signature: A hierarchy of at least two views over one collection, ordered by an aggregation relation: the coarse view displays a function of many items, the fine view displays items themselves. A selection in the coarse view is a filter that defines the fine view's contents, and the levels are simultaneously present or one-click reachable. The ordering is asymmetric — the fine level cannot substitute for the coarse one.

dimension.category_description: How evidence, internals, correspondence, quality, interpretations, and planned actions are represented for human judgment.
dimension.classification_boundary: The representation must support understanding or verification, rather than merely render output into a usable medium.
